prompt: Create a production transparent RGBA sprite atlas for the gritty Japanese post-apocalyptic side-view defense game Nishijin Seikimatsu Monogatari. Exactly FIVE horizontally separated full silhouettes, ordered left to right: perimeter idle, incoming enemy warning, impact on the defended line, successful evacuation, failed defense. Same compact portable perimeter marker in every state: a low scuffed olive sandbag bundle, short yellow-and-black striped steel barricade rail, one short industrial signal bollard at its right edge. Ground-level object, broad low footprint, NOT a tall wall, no vehicle, no characters, no writing or symbols. State 1 unlit amber lens, stable intact rail and sandbags; state 2 bright red warning light, rail intact; state 3 fresh impact dent in the rail, a small contained shower of amber metal sparks and displaced sand, red warning lens; state 4 calm green signal, intact or lightly worn secured rail and sandbags; state 5 rail collapsed and bollard bent with dark unlit broken glass and spilled sand, no active fire. Gritty detailed 2D game illustration with sharp readable silhouette, three-quarter side view, consistent camera and lighting and scale, neutral warm-gray metal and olive cloth with restrained colored lenses, no glossy neon aura. Every object and spark stays inside its own column with wide completely transparent gaps, no adjacent touching parts. Shared ground baseline, equal-sized cells, generous transparent outer margins. Truly transparent alpha background, no painted checkerboard, no background scenery, no shadows extending between cells, no headings or state labels. Wide horizontal atlas approximately 5:2.
purpose: Design Lock 17.5 authored perimeter, incoming, impact, success states and an explicit failure state. Shared objective marker; no mission mechanics changes.
